conditions.protocol: 128 forced outputs, one warmup and two measured repetitions per case, nothing cached; decode rate excludes the first token; prefill is prompt tokens over time to first token. Fixture: the 161/448/910-token prompts of current-matrix-summary.json. Short: the prose/code/scheduling prompts of nemotron-gemma-mtp-summary.json rendered with the 12B chat template.

configurations.baseline: main 90c147d3 with the deployed 4K libraries: TIR attention, FP16 assistant over padded 4K states, controller with host copies, two proposals
configurations.full: deploy/xavier/gemma4-12b-full.conf with the libraries of scripts/build_xavier_contexts.sh: tensor-core attention over the cached pages, vectorized weight expansion for prefill, small-batch projections with grouped arithmetic, 4-bit assistant attending the valid context, GPU-resident controller, three proposals

steps.name: controller
steps.change: + GPU-resident controller (states, hidden rows and token selection stay on the device)

steps.name: attention
steps.change: + tensor-core attention over the cached pages (MLC_GEMMA4_MTP_PREFILL=paged)

steps.name: expansion
steps.change: + vectorized expansion of the 4-bit weights for prefill (MLC_XAVIER_DEQUANT=1)

steps.name: assistant_attention
steps.change: + assistant attending the valid context only (MLC_E4B_MTP_ATTN=1)

steps.name: full
steps.change: + small-batch projections with grouped arithmetic (MLC_XAVIER_Q4=2) and a four-row verification step (MLC_MTP_VERIFY_LEN=4): two or three proposals

three_proposals_with_tiled_projections.note: Before the grouped arithmetic a fourth verification row cost about 12 ms, and three proposals were slower than two on prose and scheduling.

profile.note: One call, synchronized; context is the number of cached tokens. Verification of n rows, a 512-row prefill chunk and one assistant step, ms.

projection_kernel.note: Microbenchmark of the projections of one 12B step (calls weighted by their count per step), ms; scripts/bench_xavier_q4.py

cached_conversation.note: Not part of the adapter: the conversation cache of the Nemotron adapter driving the 12B libraries (expansion target, FP16 assistant attending the valid context, two proposals), K/V budget 4,096 tokens. A budget of 8,192 failed to allocate.

equivalence.teacher_forced_note: Tokens forced to the baseline's plain outputs of the fixture, one-row and three-row steps (FP16 assistant libraries; the target alone decides the logits).

four_row_library_two_proposals.note: same sources with MLC_MTP_VERIFY_LEN=3 and 4, tiled projections

equivalence.assistant_attention: E4B outputs bit-identical to the published kernel in 20 of 20 cases; 12B head layout within two FP16 steps of an FP32 reference plus the rounding of one score (tests/python/op/test_gemma4_mtp_attention.py)
equivalence.paged_attention_e4b: bit-identical to the published kernel in 35 of 35 cases, time ratio 0.97-1.02 (the layer kind is a compile-time parameter)

both_models_one_process.note: Nemotron (full profile) and the 12B through its adapter with every option, two turns each: the tokens of their single-model runs

nemotron_rebuilt_from_these_sources.note: target compiled from these sources with MLC_XAVIER_Q4=1, full profile

nemotron_nov7_profile_with_these_sources.note: published libraries, assistants by context bucket, through the shared controller

equivalence.qualification: Changed tokens are near-tie flips of greedy decoding; no task-quality benchmark was run.
